description: This source file manages temporary object directory creation, migration, cleanup, and environment setup within a version control system, likely Git. It defines structures and functions for handling temporary directories, environment variables, and migration of object files, including cleanup routines and safeguards for singleton usage.

classes.name: struct tmp_objdir
classes.description: Represents a temporary object directory, including repository context, path buffer, environment variables, previous source, and destruction flags.

methods.name: void tmp_objdir_free(struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a tmp_objdir instance, releasing buffers and freeing memory.

methods.name: int tmp_objdir_destroy(struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Destroys the temporary object directory, restoring previous sources if needed, removing directories, and freeing resources.

methods.name: void remove_tmp_objdir(void)
methods.description: A static cleanup function registered with atexit to remove the singleton tmp_objdir when the process exits.

methods.name: void tmp_objdir_discard_objects(struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Removes the directory associated with the tmp_objdir but keeps the top-level directory.

methods.name: void env_append(struct strvec * env,const char * key,const char * val)
methods.description: Appends a value to an environment variable, quoting if necessary, adding it to the environment vector.

methods.name: void env_replace(struct strvec * env,const char * key,const char * val)
methods.description: Replaces an environment variable with a new value in the environment vector.

methods.name: int setup_tmp_objdir(const char * root)
methods.description: Creates the 'pack' subdirectory inside a given root directory.

methods.name: struct:tmp_objdir * tmp_objdir_create(struct repository * r,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Creates a new temporary object directory, setting up environment variables, ensuring singleton usage, and registering cleanup routines.

methods.name: int pack_copy_priority(const char * name)
methods.description: Determines the priority of pack files based on their name suffixes, used for ordering.

methods.name: int pack_copy_cmp(const char * a,const char * b)
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting pack files based on their priority.

methods.name: int read_dir_paths(struct string_list * out,const char * path)
methods.description: Reads directory entries into a string list, excluding hidden files.

methods.name: int migrate_paths(struct tmp_objdir * t,struct strbuf * src,struct strbuf * dst,enum finalize_object_file_flags flags)
methods.description: Migrates directory contents from source to destination paths based on the provided flags.

methods.name: int migrate_one(struct tmp_objdir * t,struct strbuf * src,struct strbuf * dst,enum finalize_object_file_flags flags)
methods.description: Migrates a single object or directory from source to destination, finalizing object files or recursing into directories.

methods.name: int is_loose_object_shard(const char * name)
methods.description: Checks if a filename matches the pattern of a loose object shard based on its name.

methods.name: int tmp_objdir_migrate(struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Migrates objects from the tmp_objdir to the main object directory, restoring previous sources if needed, then destroys the tmp_objdir.

methods.name: const char ** tmp_objdir_env(const struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Returns the environment variables associated with the tmp_objdir.

methods.name: void tmp_objdir_add_as_alternate(const struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Adds the tmp_objdir as an alternate object database.

methods.name: void tmp_objdir_replace_primary_odb(struct tmp_objdir * t,int will_destroy)
methods.description: Replaces the primary object database with the tmp_objdir, optionally marking the old source for destruction.

methods.name: struct:tmp_objdir * tmp_objdir_unapply_primary_odb(void)
methods.description: Restores the previous primary object database if the tmp_objdir replaced it.

methods.name: void tmp_objdir_reapply_primary_odb(struct tmp_objdir * t,const char * old_cwd,const char * new_cwd)
methods.description: Reapplies the primary object database after changing directories.
